data.name: Helve
data.long_meaning:
The name Helve is derived from the ancient Roman word 'helvus'. It is a compound name made up of 'hel' meaning 'hidden' and 've' meaning 'strength'. Helve was a name given to those who were considered strong and hidden, often used for those in protective roles such as soldiers or guards.
The name Helve also has spiritual significance in Christianity, as it is believed to represent the strength and hidden nature of God.
